title: The Morning Digest: October 18, 2026
dek: Markets are closed for the weekend and Saturday produced no fresh attacks, statements, or flow updates, so Friday's settles remain the tape: Brent Dec26 at $109.86 and WTI Nov26 at $101.41. The refreshed validated crack history revises Friday's diesel crack close to $99.35, below $100, ending the streak above $100 at nine days; the figure printed in Saturday's edition ($104.35) came from that morning's data pull and is superseded. Friday's ICE file, which reached this run after Saturday's edition, puts WCS Dec26 at -$27.40 (ICE TMW settle, Oct 16), the widest print of the episode on thin volume, with the January to June tenors widening $1.05 to $1.20 on traded volume. SYN Nov26 settled at +$7.57 in the first session after the Syncrude coker window wrapped. Riyadh airport's resumption is unconfirmed hours after its closure notice expired, and the SPR 40 Mbbl award is twelve days pending.
